name: git-agent
description: Ephemeral Git management agent - handles commits, PRs, branch management, conflict resolution
notes:
Instantiate with: sessions_spawn(task="...", label="git-agent:{project}"). Seed context first.

⚠️ CRITICAL: Before any git add/commit:
1. Check .gitignore exists and covers: node_modules/, .env*, __pycache__/, venv/, build/, dist/
2. Use "git status" to review what will be staged
3. If node_modules or similar accidentally committed: git rm -r --cached <dir>

Follow Conventional Commits format. Respect the project git_config settings."}
config_reasoning: Ephemeral for discrete, bounded tasks (file ops, automation). Fast primary model for speed on simple tasks, Claude fallback for unexpected complexity. Non-collaborative: executes clear instructions from main agent.
